entities.name: Benzir
entities.description: Sylvok arch-druid of Temple Might in the Tangle on Mirrodin, later compleated but still loyal to Glissa.

entities.name: Temple Might
entities.description: Temple in the Tangle where Benzir was head druid and Kessla lived.

entities.name: Kessla
entities.description: Sylvok who used to live at Temple Might and witnessed the altercation.

entities.name: Camik
entities.description: Man whose arrest and execution Benzir ordered.

entities.name: Glissa
entities.description: Figure to whom Benzir appears loyal.

entities.name: Phyrexians

events.summary: During the Phyrexian invasion, Benzir orders the arrest and eventual execution of Camik.
events.quote: he ordered the arrest and eventual execution of a man named Camik.

events.summary: Benzir is compleated under Phyrexia's rule.

relations.note: He appears to be loyal to Glissa.
